action.action-desc: Mr. Figures introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce

form.official-title: To amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 to terminate Federal student loan limits and restore the availability of Federal Direct PLUS Loans for graduate and professional students.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Restoring Opportunity for Advanced Education Act.

section.header: Termination of loan limits and restoration of Federal Direct PLUS Loans for graduate and professional students

subsection.text: Section 455(a) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1087e(a)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in the paragraph heading, by striking and federal direct plus loans;

clause.text: by striking the heading for subparagraph (A) and inserting the following: In general;
in the matter preceding clause (i), by inserting before the dash at the end the following: , for any period of instruction beginning on or after July 1, 2012;
in clause (i), by striking for any period of instruction beginning on or after July 1, 2012,; and
in clause (ii), by striking for any period of instruction beginning on July 1, 2012, and ending on June 30, 2026,; and

paragraph.text: by redesignating paragraph (5), (7), and (8) as paragraphs (4), (5), and (6), respectively.

subsection.text: Section 455(a) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1087e(a)), as amended by subsection (a), is further amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (4), as redesignated by subsection (a), by striking paragraph (8) and inserting paragraph (6) both places the term appears; and

in paragraph (6), as redesignated by subsection (a), by striking Paragraphs (3)(C), (4), (5), and (6) shall not apply, and paragraph (3)(A)(ii) shall apply as such paragraph was in effect for periods of instruction ending before June 30, 2026, and inserting Paragraph (4) shall not apply.
